candidates.phrase: the Father is the Source of all that exists
candidates.rationale: Asserts the Father as ultimate, underived source of all reality, implying He is not generated from another.
candidates.chunk_text: We believe the Father is the Source of all that exists, whether of matter or spirit. With the Son and the Holy Spirit, He made man, male and female, in His image. By intention He relates to people as Father, thereby forever declaring His goodwill toward them. In love, He both seeks and receives penitent sinners.
